name: archi-ai-labs
description: Claude Code plugins by Archi AI Labs

plugins.name: trim-kit
plugins.description: A small toolkit for setting up and maintaining Claude Code configuration per project. No hooks, no agents, no MCP - plain skills only.

plugins.name: docs-kit
plugins.description: Three-layer docs workflow as an installable unit: scaffold the structure (docs-init), reconcile docs with what a session actually did (docs-sync), validate deterministically (docs-check), render an HTML docs site (docs-render), and turn settled decisions into a delegation prompt (brief). Warn-only hooks enforce Architecture-via-Decision and sensitive-change traceability.
